diagnostics.frame_setup_cpu_scope: Engine-wide rendering setup CPU time, shared across viewports.
diagnostics.gpu_timing_note: GPU timing may be delayed; zero is ambiguous between unavailable and zero measured time.
diagnostics.render_cpu_scope: Viewport rendering CPU only; excludes script and other engine CPU.
diagnostics.render_memory_note: Rendering memory values are engine estimates in bytes, not process RSS or free VRAM.
diagnostics.static_memory_note: Godot static memory may be unavailable in release builds and can report zero.

method: Same process, alternating baseline/candidate order, 5 fixed views, 3 pairs, 12 warmup and 24 measured native frames per view; median timings are observations under a shared active desktop, not an FPS guarantee. No scenery, simulation, crash bodies or other aircraft are included.
